mapper.select: SELECT id, name, workID AS workId, departmentId, posId AS positionId, workState FROM employee WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.workID AS workId, e.departmentId, e.posId AS positionId, e.workState, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS positionName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = e.departmentId LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = e.posId WHERE e.workState = '在职'
AND (e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.workID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY e.workID, e.id LIMIT 30
SELECT id, name, enabled, parentId FROM department ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, enabled FROM position ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, enabled FROM department WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, enabled FROM position WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM employeeremove WHERE requestId = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET departmentId = #{afterDepId}, posId = #{afterJobId} WHERE id = #{eid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employeeremove (eid, beforeDepId, beforeJobId, afterDepId, afterJobId, employeeName, workId, beforeDepName, beforeJobName, afterDepName, afterJobName, removeDate, reason, remark, operatorId, operatorName, createdAt, requestId) VALUES (#{eid}, #{beforeDepId}, #{beforeJobId}, #{afterDepId}, #{afterJobId}, #{employeeName}, #{workId}, #{beforeDepName}, #{beforeJobName}, #{afterDepName}, #{afterJobName}, #{removeDate}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createdAt}, #{requestId})

INSERT INTO oplog (addDate, operate, hrid, transferId, operatorName, createdAt) VALUES (#{removeDate}, CONCAT('员工调动 #', #{id}, '：', #{employeeName}, '（', COALESCE(#{workId}, ''), '）'), #{operatorId}, #{id}, #{operatorName}, #{createdAt})

where.if: AND (COALESCE(t.employeeName, e.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(t.workId, e.workID) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.eid, t.beforeDepId, t.beforeJobId, t.afterDepId, t.afterJobId, COALESCE(t.employeeName, e.name) AS employeeName, COALESCE(t.workId, e.workID) AS workId, t.beforeDepName, t.beforeJobName, t.afterDepName, t.afterJobName, t.removeDate, t.createdAt, t.reason, t.remark, t.operatorId, t.operatorName FROM employeeremove t LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = t.eid
ORDER BY COALESCE(t.createdAt, t.removeDate) DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employeeremove t LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = t.eid
mapper.sql: FROM oplog l LEFT JOIN hr h ON h.id = l.hrid LEFT JOIN employeeremove t ON t.id = l.transferId

where.if: AND (l.operate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR t.employeeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR t.workId LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.transferId, l.hrid AS operatorId, COALESCE(l.operatorName, h.name) AS operatorName, COALESCE(l.createdAt, l.addDate) AS createdAt, l.operate, l.details, t.employeeName, t.workId, t.beforeDepName, t.beforeJobName, t.afterDepName, t.afterJobName, t.reason, t.remark
ORDER BY COALESCE(l.createdAt, l.addDate) DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
